newsitem.title: USA: GM unit says plant sales fits its goal.
newsitem.headline: GM unit says plant sales fits its goal.

text.p: Delphi Interior & Lighting Systems, a unit of General Motors Corp, said the sale of four of its component parts plants to Peregrine Inc is in keeping with the company's goal.

In a statement, Delphi Interior general manager Paul Tosch said, "In selling these facilities our goal was threefold: to provide continued employment to the employees, provide ongoing support of the local communities and to ensure continued high quality parts for our customers. The sale to Peregrine achieves our goal."
The plants are in Flint and Livonia, Mich. and Windsor and Oshawa, Ontario.
